newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA C. BANK FOREX RESERVES FELL TO $415 MLN.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA C. BANK FOREX RESERVES FELL TO $415 MLN.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) foreign exchange reserves fell by $103 million to $415 million on January 31, the BNB said in a statement on Tuesday.
The BNB paid by $135.1 million coupon on January 28 on Brady bonds issued to restructure a $8.16 million commercial foreign debt two years ago.
Reserves have sunk to their minimum as Bulgaria is undergoing its worst financial crisis caused by mismanagement of the economy by the ruling ex-communists.
The BNB has been unable to support the plummeting national currency on the local interbank forex market in the past weeks.
The lev hit a new all-time low on Tuesday of 3,000 to the dollar from 2,800 on Monday close.
